start.dialog: The magma flows speak to me, friend. Deep within Mount Pyralis lies a fire gem of unmatched purity—touched by the First Flame itself. But the path is treacherous. Lava worms, flame elementals, and worse guard the depths. Are you brave enough to descend?
start.objective: Enter Mount Pyralis and retrieve the Primal Fire Gem

progress.dialog: You're halfway through the magma chamber! The heat is intense—my instruments are melting just thinking about it. The gem pulses ahead, but so does something... large. Keep your cool, literally!
progress.objective: Navigate the magma chamber and defeat the Lava Worm guardian

complete.dialog: You actually survived! And brought the gem! This is magnificent—feel its warmth? This will keep Cinderstep heated for a decade. The Deep Forge Guild will sing songs of your bravery!

party_comments.kade: Going INTO a volcano? The things I do for adventure...
party_comments.twist: My spells are literally evaporating in this heat. Can we hurry?
party_comments.nix7: Internal temperature critical. Recommend immediate completion of objective.
